method: Pair exact primary GS_<id>, <id>_WB, and <id>_Ability filenames under Common/Hardware/Weapons; include XML overlay candidates even if the raw capture is absent. Identity mapping is annotation only.

sampleWeaponReference.meaning: Registry leaf reference; not proof of mode or MP availability.

mpReferenceReview.meaning: Registry leaves and presentation-extension records require traced MP loadout/mode consumers before they can classify a weapon.
